sources.title: lunar_lander_ppo.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: We use the Stable-Baselines3 implementation of PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) to train an agent that lands a spacecraft on the moon. Runtime tip: for PPO with an MLP policy, CPU is actually faster than GPU (the policy net is tiny and the bottleneck is environment stepping).
